page.layout: One block of verse in italic, set in the left-centre of the page, with a catchword "Tar-" at the lower right of the text block; page number 63 at top right. No margin notes.

p.i: Aoniæ Pubis, densâ quâ floruit olim,
Celsa sed imprimis Mystarum nomina, cælo
Queis demum caput exeruit, queis quâ patet orbis
Didita Nassovicæ resonavit gloria Terræ;
Annuè si qua placent unquam pia vota, precamur
Testamurque tuum Numen, per dulcia pacis
Munera, per quæ jam nobis facis otia, perque
Hæc nova, queis renitet facies renovata, Lycéi,
Ornamenta; tuì totidem monumenta favoris
Signaque certa Patris cujus furor iraque ponit;
Quinper priscatui dum Te testamur amoris
Munera, queis famâ magnis certavit Athenis
Parva quidem spaciis Herborna; in millibus Oræ
Teutonicæ, sed magna suis Ancilibus olim,
Dexter ades nobis! iterum nos respice Lenis!
Nec jurata velis ad tempus fœdera demum
Sed Salis ac æterna tuæ parvæque Zoari,
Quæ validos licet haud vallos, cæloque superbos,
Vel Moles, Fossasve crepet, tutosve Receptus,
Arx tamen, hoc meminisse velis, Fortissima Veri
Extitit & verâ pro Religione Celebres
Pugnavit pugnas, Illustribus aucta triumphis
Vaejove Tarpeio vario vel ab hoste relatis.
Te rursus testamur enim per nomina priscūm
Heroum, qui Sancta Poli mysteria rarâ
Fruge recludentes varios in lecta Sionis
Formârunt hic vasa Tuæ, dispersa per orbem
Quà late patet, & quà sidus currit utrumque.
Priscatui hæc meminisse velis monumenta favoris!
Demememinisse velis ingrati oblivia nostri
Pectoris! haud bona nostra quibus cognovimus olim!
Quæ vetuére tui meritò frueremur eodem
Lumine munifici vultus, quod Lumen Athenis
Nostris omne dabat: Nos ultrò quippe fatemur
Nostra tulisse tuis sufflamen crimina donis
Nostraque crevisse heu! ingrati crimina cordis,
Munera dum crevère tui nos versus amoris;
Verùm respice nos, & ades, Pater Optime, dexter,
Dum Te testamur per Te, per viscera Patris
Suppliciis animi fractorum prona moveri,

page.notes: The first line is a fragment of a line whose opening letters are heavily set; the page carries show-through from the reverse (faint printed text in the upper right and right margin), which is omitted. The catchword "Tar-" is printed at the lower right of the text block. "Demememinisse" and "priscūm" are printed as they appear; the reading of a few words is doubtful.
